paragraphs: At Clover Health, our vision is to empower every physician with technology to identify, manage, and treat chronic diseases earlier. This results in earlier diagnosis and treatment, earlier disease management and more affordable and accessible care. Our strategy is to improve the care of our Medicare Advantage ("MA") members, develop wide physician networks, and provide technology to help empower physicians. Our proprietary software platform, Clover Assistant (licensed externally as Counterpart Assistant), supports clinical real-time decision making at the point of care by equipping the clinical with data and insights. This helps us execute our strategy by enabling physicians to detect, identify, and manage chronic diseases better than they otherwise could. This technology is a cloud-based software platform that curates data from over 100 sources and provides physicians with access to data-driven insights and personalized care recommendations for the patients. Our differentiated approach can be summarized as follows:

(1)Represents full year 2025 Benefits expense ratio ("BER") for Clover Health, as well as most recent results of other public companies with "Traditional MA Plan" approaches that have reported results as of the time of this publication. BER is a non-GAAP financial measure. We calculate our BER by taking the total of Insurance net medical expenses incurred and quality improvements, and dividing that total by premiums earned on a net basis, in a given period. Please refer to the Company's Key Performance Measures included in Part II, Item 7 of this Form 10-K, for a reconciliation of BER to Insurance Net medical claims incurred, net, the most directly comparable GAAP measure.

Provider use of Clover Assistant enables data-driven clinical decision-making that benefits our members and drives rapid software iteration: the more that providers use Clover Assistant, the more it learns and furthers the precision of personalized data-driven recommendations. We combine our beneficiary data with provider-generated data and use this powerful closed feedback loop to continuously fine-tune our proprietary clinical rules and machine learning models, as well as to select and prioritize future software capabilities. We believe the use and continuous improvement of Clover Assistant has resulted in not only improved clinical decision-making but also enhanced MA plan performance. The platform facilitates identifying and engaging with our most at-risk members for our clinical programs. These programs are designed to provide additional targeted care support and to further drive better plan performance.

We leverage Clover Assistant in our Preferred Provider Organization ("PPO") and Health Maintenance Organization ("HMO") plans. We aim to provide affordable, high-quality healthcare and we offer most of our members (referred to as "members") in our Medicare Advantage ("MA") plans among the lowest average out-of-pocket costs for primary care provider ("PCP") and specialist co-pays in their respective markets. We strongly believe in providing our members with provider choice and consider our PPO plans to be our flagship insurance product. An important feature of our MA product is its wide physician network. We often offer the same cost-sharing (co-pays and deductibles) for visits with primary care providers who are in-network and out-of-network. We manage care on our wide network by empowering providers with intuitive data-driven, personalized insights for their patients (our members) through the use of Clover Assistant. We believe this enables providers to make improved clinical decisions. We reach a broad array of consumers, including traditionally underserved markets. At January 1, 2026, we operated our MA plans in five states and 203 counties.

We complement our wide-network physicians and their patients with our longitudinal home-based primary care program for our highest acuity members, Clover Home Care, powered by Clover Assistant. This program covers the most medically complex patients, often with advanced co-morbidities. We believe Clover Assistant makes home care for high-risk individuals more scalable than fixed-site-based care. It permits technology deployment to enhance care and outcomes directly where patients live because our value proposition is centered around software. Clover Home Care seeks to preserve the PCP-to-patient relationship through collaboration, which aims to improve health outcomes and reduce medical expenses.

We have made it a priority to work with Medicare eligible seniors in underserved markets. This includes MA members diagnosed with at least two chronic diseases, as well as members living in communities that fall within the top five deciles of what the government defines as areas of socioeconomic deprivation. We are heavily invested in helping provide care for those who are most in need.

During 2024, the Company launched Counterpart Health, Inc., a new Software-as-a-Service ("SaaS") and Tech Enabled Services Solution to bring the power of Clover Assistant technology to external payors and providers serving the Medicare eligible population. This external offering aims to equip clinician users with the Company's already built, clinician-centric, and AI-powered care management platform. Strategically, Counterpart Health, Inc., a subsidiary of Clover Health, aims to extend the benefits of proven data-driven technology and personalized care to a wider audience, enabling enhanced patient outcomes and reduced healthcare costs across the nation. Counterpart Health is complementary to Clover Health, and enables the Company to deploy and expand the reach of its existing technology asset for new potential growth and high margin business opportunities, with low startup costs. Unless the context otherwise provides, references to Clover Assistant in this report also refer to Counterpart Assistant, as applicable. We are continuing external commercialization efforts through Counterpart Health, to bring Clover's care model to more plans and providers nationwide. Counterpart Health is not yet significant to our overall business or results of operations. We remain focused on increasing total lives on Counterpart Health alongside Clover's growing Medicare Advantage Plan.

Clover Health was incorporated on October 18, 2019, as a special purpose acquisition company and a Cayman Islands exempted company under the name Social Capital Hedosophia Holdings Corp. III ("SCH"). On April 24, 2020, SCH completed its initial public offering. On January 7, 2021, SCH consummated a business combination with Clover Health Investments, Corp. and changed its name to Clover Health Investments, Corp. We are a remote first company. Accordingly, we do not maintain a headquarters. Stockholder communications required to be sent to our principal executive offices may be directed to the email address: secretary@cloverhealth.com, or to our agent for service of process at The Corporation Trust Company, 1209 Orange Street, Wilmington, Delaware 19801. Our telephone number is (201) 432-2133. Our website address is www.cloverhealth.com. The information contained on or accessible through our website is not part of this Annual Report on Form 10-K and is not incorporated by reference in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

We believe we have an opportunity to fundamentally change healthcare by providing easy access to care via technology-enabled providers across the country. By leveraging our Clover Assistant platform, we believe we can raise the level of care provided by every provider and scale in ways that traditional managed care plans and risk-bearing provider groups cannot. We principally scale our model of care by deploying physician-enablement software to providers. We do this primarily by entering into contracts with our providers in which they agree to use Clover Assistant in connection with their primary care office visits in exchange for a flat fee. Our platform, which enables differentiated patient care, supports our expansion into virtually any market, including traditionally underserved markets that are generally not viable for others because those markets often lack providers willing or able to assume financial risk for the costs of patient care.

Medicare is the focal point of our opportunity. Approximately 70 million people were enrolled in Medicare in 2025. That number is expected to rise, equating to approximately $1.5 trillion in total expenditures by 2030. Within Medicare, the MA market made up approximately $545 billion of annual spend in 2025 and is expected to grow to approximately $916 billion by 2030. Original Medicare is expected to grow from $475 billion to $630 billion over the same period.

For a given patient, we aim to equip physicians utilizing Clover Assistant with synthesized sets of collated and actionable data, to identify, manage and subsequently treat disease burdens earlier. The combination of these features enables physicians to deliver a better patient experience for our beneficiaries, as physicians are able to more effectively identify clinical opportunities to treat patients using data-driven, personalized insights.

Clover Assistant is a purpose-built technology platform that empowers providers to deliver intuitive data-driven, personalized care to help physicians detect, identify, and manage diseases earlier. This physician-enablement platform is designed to synthesize comprehensive, longitudinal sets of data to generate provider-focused machine learning, artificial intelligence and rules-based insights, and to drive action by surfacing the most relevant, personalized information about each patient to his or her provider. Through this democratization of data access for providers, we seek to reduce the variability in clinical decision-making, drive improved adherence to evidence-based protocols, and help providers deliver better care. Our proprietary technology platform is at the center of the Company's technology-first approach to driving better care management. headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry
We have incurred net losses in the past, and we may not be able to achieve or maintain profitability in the future.
Our long-term success depends on maintaining and continuing to improve CA, and the expansion of CA to external partners, as such, our past results may not be indicative of future performance.

If adoption and use of Clover Assistant is lower than we expect, our growth may slow or stall. We may experience a decline in our lives under Clover management, and our results of operations could be adversely affected.
CMS's risk adjustment payment system makes our revenues and profitability difficult to predict and could result in material retroactive adjustments to our results of operations.
We may require additional capital to support business growth, and this capital might not be available on acceptable terms, or at all.
If we are unable to succeed in maintaining or expanding the number of members under our MA plans, our business, financial condition, and results of operations could be harmed.
Our members remain concentrated in certain geographic areas and populations, which exposes us to unfavorable changes in local benefit costs, reimbursement rates, competition, and economic conditions.
Our results of operations may be adversely affected if we are unable to grow our provider networks or contract with providers, medical facilities, and other entities on competitive terms.
We may be unable to effectively manage our growth, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
We operate in a competitive industry, and if we are not able to compete effectively, our business, financial condition, and results of operations will be harmed.
We compete with larger companies that may have stronger brands, and consolidation among competitors would increase competition.
Our failure to estimate incurred but not reported claims accurately would affect our results of operations.

If we are unable to expand our sales and marketing infrastructure or if we fail to overcome challenges relating to marketing of our business, we may fail to enroll sufficient members to meet our forecasts.
If we fail to develop widespread brand recognition or are unable to maintain or enhance our reputation, our business, financial condition, and results of operations will be harmed.

If we do not continue to innovate and provide services that are useful to our members and providers, we may not remain competitive, and our business, financial condition, and results of operations could suffer.
If we fail to offer high-quality customer support, our business, results of operations and reputation could suffer.
Real or perceived errors, failures, vulnerabilities, or bugs in Clover Assistant would harm our business, results of operations, and financial condition.
If we fail to manage our technical operations infrastructure, or experience service outages, interruptions, or delays in the deployment of our platform, our results of operations may be harmed.
paragraphs: In the course of conducting our business operations, we are exposed to a variety of risks, any of which have affected or could materially adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations. The market price of our common stock could decline, possibly significantly and permanently, if one or more of these risks and uncertainties occurs. Any factor described in this report or in any of our other SEC filings could by itself, or together with other factors, adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations.

We have incurred net losses of $85.5 million, $46.3 million, and $210.1 million for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively, and as of December 31, 2025 we had an accumulated deficit of approximately $2.3 billion. We may continue to incur losses in the near term as we continue to invest significant additional funds towards growing our business. In particular, we expect to continue to invest in improving Clover Assistant and our technology infrastructure, developing our clinical care programs, increasing adoption of the Clover Assistant platform, including through Counterpart Health, expanding our marketing and outreach efforts, expanding our operations geographically, and developing future offerings that improve care and supplement our revenue streams. These efforts may prove more expensive than we currently anticipate, and we may not succeed in increasing our revenue sufficiently to offset these expenses. Even if we are successful in increasing our Total revenues from Insurance premiums earned, we may not successfully and effectively predict, price, and manage the medical costs.

Furthermore, we may not be able to sustain profitability in subsequent periods. Our cash flows from operations were negative for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2023 and positive for the year ended December 31, 2024, and we may not generate positive cash flow from operations in any given period. If we are not able to maintain profitability or achieve positive cash flow, we will require additional financing, which may not be available on favorable terms, or at all, and which could be dilutive to our stockholders. See the risk factor entitled "We may require additional capital to support business growth, and this capital might not be available on acceptable terms, or at all." If we are unable to successfully address these risks and challenges as we encounter them, our business may be harmed, which could negatively affect the value of our common stock.

Since launching Clover Assistant in 2018, we have continued to develop its features and capabilities, adapt our go-to-market strategy and adjust its integration with our MA plans and third-party systems. As a result, we may not fully understand the impact of Clover Assistant on our future business and long-term prospects. Our continued long-term success depends on maintaining and continuing to improve Clover Assistant and the margins we generate from its operations over time in the markets we currently serve or potential future markets. There can be no assurance that these effects will continue to improve or persist over time in our current markets or that we can replicate these results as we expand into new markets, and the failure to do so may have a negative effect on our business and results of operations. See the risk factor entitled "Our launch of Counterpart Assistant as a Software-as-a-Service ("SaaS") product for external payors and providers serving the Medicare eligible population may not be successful, and, as a result, our business may be adversely affected."

Our launch of Counterpart Assistant as a Software-as-a-Service ("SaaS") product for external payors and providers serving the Medicare eligible population may not be successful, and, as a result, our business may be adversely affected.

During the second quarter of 2024, we launched Counterpart Health, Inc. ("Counterpart Health"), a subsidiary of the Company which houses a SaaS and tech-enabled services solution to bring the power of Clover Assistant technology to external payors and providers serving the Medicare eligible population under the brand name "Counterpart Assistant," with the aim to extend the benefits of data-driven proven technology and personalized care to a wider audience, enabling enhanced patient outcomes and reduced healthcare costs across the nation. Counterpart Assistant is complementary to Clover Assistant, and, unless the context otherwise provides, references to the risks associated with Clover Assistant in this report also refer to risks associated with Counterpart Assistant, as applicable.

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis provides information that management believes is relevant to an assessment and understanding of our consolidated results of operations and financial condition. The discussion should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and notes thereto for the year ended December 31, 2025, contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K (the "Form 10-K"). The following discussion and analysis does not include certain items related to the year ended December 31, 2024, including year-to-year comparisons between the year ended December 31, 2024 and the year ended December 31, 2023. For a discussion of these items and comparison of our results of operations for the fiscal years ended December 31, 2024 and December 31, 2023, see Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024, filed with the SEC on March 3, 2025. This discussion contains forward-looking statements and involves numerous risks and uncertainties, including, but not limited to, those described in the "Risk Factors" section of this Form 10-K. Actual results may differ materially from those contained in any forward-looking statements. See "Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" for additional information. Unless the context otherwise requires, references in this "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" to "we," "us," "our," "Clover," "Clover Health," and the "Company" mean the business and operations of Clover Health Investments, Corp. and its consolidated subsidiaries.

At Clover Health, our vision is to empower every physician with the technology to identify, manage, and treat chronic diseases earlier. Our strategy is to improve the care of people with Medicare, develop wide physician networks, and provide technology to help empower physicians. Our proprietary software platform, Clover Assistant (licensed externally as Counterpart Assistant), helps us execute this strategy by enabling physicians to detect, identify, and manage chronic diseases earlier than they otherwise could. This technology is a cloud-based software platform that provides physicians with access to data-driven and personalized insights for the patients they treat.

We operate Preferred Provider Organization ("PPO") and Health Maintenance Organization ("HMO") Medicare Advantage ("MA") plans for Medicare-eligible individuals. We aim to provide high-quality, affordable healthcare for all Medicare beneficiaries. Among plans with similar major characteristics, we offer most members in our MA plans (the "members") among the lowest average out-of-pocket costs for primary care provider and specialist co-pays in their markets. We strongly believe in providing our members provider choice, and we consider our PPO plans to be our flagship insurance product. An important feature of our MA product is wide network access. We believe the use of Clover Assistant and related data insights allows us to improve clinical decision-making through a highly scalable platform. At December 31, 2025, we operated our MA plans in five states and 200 counties, with 113,803 members.

On January 14, 2026, the Company announced a 53% year-over-year growth of its MA membership during the most recent Annual Election Period. The Company entered 2026 with over 153,000 members, over 97% of whom are enrolled in the Company's flagship PPO plans.
Beginning in 2026, our MA plans will be available in a total of 203 counties and five states.

On October 9, 2025, the Company announced that CMS has decreased the Star rating of its PPO Medicare Advantage plans to 3.5 Stars for Star rating year 2026, which will affect payment year 2027. Additionally, CMS increased the rating of Clover's HMO MA plan to 4.0 Stars. Currently over 97% of our insurance members are members of our PPO Medicare Advantage Plans.

We manage our operations based on one reportable segment: Insurance. Through our Insurance segment, we provide PPO and HMO plans to Medicare Advantage members in several states. All other clinical services and all corporate overhead not included in the reportable segments are included in Corporate/Other.

The segment grouping is consistent with the information used by our Chief Executive Officer (identified as our chief operating decision maker) ("CODM") to assess performance and allocate the Company's resources.

We review several key performance measures, discussed below, to evaluate our business and results, measure performance, identify trends, formulate plans, and make strategic decisions. We believe that the presentation of such metrics is useful to management and counterparties to model the performance of healthcare companies such as Clover.

Through our Insurance segment, we provide PPO and HMO plans to members in several states. We seek to improve care and lower costs for our members by empowering providers with intuitive data-driven, personalized insights to support treatment of members through our software platform, Clover Assistant.

paragraphs: 在 Clover Health，我們的願景是透過科技賦能每位醫師，以更早識別、管理與治療慢性疾病。這會導致更早的診斷與治療、更早的疾病管理，以及更負擔得起且更易取得的照護。我們的策略是改善我們的 Medicare Advantage（"MA"）成員的照護品質、建立廣泛的醫師網路，並提供科技協助賦能醫師。我們的專有軟體平台 Clover Assistant（外部授權為 Counterpart Assistant），透過提供臨牀資料與見解，協助臨牀端在照護現場做出即時的決策。這有助於我們執行策略，讓醫師能比否則更能有效檢測、識別與管理慢性疾病。這項科技是一項雲端軟體平台，會從超過 100 個來源整理資料，並為醫師提供資料驅動的見解與個性化照護建議。我們的差異化策略可歸納如下：

(1) 代表 Clover Health 在 2025 年全年 Benefits expense ratio（"BER"）的費用率（"BER"），以及其他採用 "Traditional MA Plan" 方式之公開公司的最新結果，這些結果是在本報告發佈時已公佈。BER 是一項非 GAAP 財務指標。我們計算 BER 的方式為將保險淨醫療費用與品質改善總額，除以淨基礎的保費收入，計算某一期間的比率。請參閱本 Form 10-K 第二部分，第 7 項所列的本公司 Key Performance Measures，以瞭解 BER 與保險淨醫療聲請金額的對應關係。

醫療機構使用 Clover Assistant 可以實現資料驅動的臨牀決策，這對我們的成員有益，並能加速軟體的迭代：醫療機構使用 Clover Assistant 的越多，該平台學習的越多，並進一步提升個性化資料驅動建議的精準度。我們將受益者資料與醫療機構產生的資料結合，並利用這強大的閉環反饋機制，持續優化我們的專有臨牀規則與機器學習模型，以及選擇與優先未來的軟體功能。我們相信 Clover Assistant 的使用與持續改進，不僅改善了臨牀決策，也提升了 MA 計畫的表現。該平台有助於識別並與我們最為高風險的成員互動，以進行我們的臨牀計畫。這些計畫設計用以提供額外的針對性照護支持，並進一步推動更好的計畫表現。

我們在 Preferred Provider Organization（"PPO"）與 Health Maintenance Organization（"HMO"）計畫中運用 Clover Assistant。我們致力於提供負擔得起且高品質的醫療照護，並為我們的 Medicare Advantage（"MA"）計畫成員（稱為 "成員"）提供其所在市場中最低的平均自付費用（"PCP"）與專科醫師共付費用。我們非常重視為成員提供醫療機構選擇，因此認為我們的 PPO 計畫是我們的旗艦保險產品。我們的 MA 產品的重要特徵之一是其廣泛的醫師網路。我們經常為在網路內與網路外的首診醫師提供相同的費用分擔（共付與自付額）。我們透過 Clover Assistant 提供臨牀端直覺的資料驅動、個性化見解，來管理我們廣泛的網路。我們相信這有助於醫療機構做出更優的臨牀決策。我們服務的消費者範圍廣泛，包括傳統上被忽略的市場。在 2026 年 1 月 1 日，我們在五個州與 203 個縣市運作 MA 計畫。

我們透過 Clover Home Care，為我們最高風險的成員提供長期居家基礎的首診照護計畫，以補足我們廣泛網路的醫師與其病患。此計畫覆蓋最為複雜的醫療需求患者，通常伴隨多重慢性疾病。我們相信 Clover Assistant 讓高風險個體的居家照護比固定場地的照護更具可擴展性。它允許透過技術部署直接在患者居住地增強照護與結果，因為我們的價值主張以軟體為中心。Clover Home Care 希望透過合作來維持 PCP 與患者的關係，目標是改善健康結果並減少醫療費用。
我們已將重點放在協助 Medicare 合格的長者，特別是在被忽略市場的長者。這包括診斷出至少兩種慢性疾病的 MA 成員，以及居住在政府定義的社會經濟貧困地區前五分位的社區的成員。我們在協助提供這些最需要照護的人羣的醫療照護上投入了大量資源。

在 2024 年，本公司發佈了 Counterpart Health, Inc.，這是一家新的 Software-as-a-Service（"SaaS"）與科技驅動服務解決方案，用以將 Clover Assistant 的技術力量帶給外部的付款者與服務 Medicare 合格人口的醫療機構。這項外部服務旨在為臨牀使用者提供本公司已建立的以臨牀為中心且 AI 驅動的照護管理平台。戰略上，Counterpart Health, Inc. 作為 Clover Health 的子公司，旨在將已證實的資料驅動技術與個性化照護的效益擴展至更廣大的羣眾，以提升全國的患者結果並降低醫療費用。Counterpart Health 與 Clover Health 互補，使本公司能部署並擴展現有技術資產的應用，以尋求新的潛在成長與高毛利業務機會，且啟動成本低。除非上下文另有說明，本報告中提及 Clover Assistant 的參考也適用於 Counterpart Assistant。我們持續透過 Counterpart Health 進行外部商業化努力，將 Clover 的照護模式帶到更多計畫與醫療機構。Counterpart Health 目前對本公司整體業務或營運結果尚不顯著。我們持續專注於增加 Counterpart Health 的總人數，同時 Clover 的 Medicare Advantage 計畫持續成長。

Clover Health 於 2019 年 10 月 18 日成立，為一特殊目的收購公司，並為開曼羣島豁免公司，名稱為 Social Capital Hedosophia Holdings Corp. III（"SCH"）。於 2020 年 4 月 24 日，SCH 完成首次公開發行。於 2021 年 1 月 7 日，SCH 完成與 Clover Health Investments, Corp. 的業務合併，並更名為 Clover Health Investments, Corp. 我們為一遠距為先的公司。因此，我們不設有總部。需發送至我們主要營業處所的股東溝通，可寄送至電子郵件地址：secretary@cloverhealth.com，或寄送至我們的訴訟代理人 The Corporation Trust Company，地址為 1209 Orange Street, Wilmington, Delaware 19801。我們的電話號碼為 (201) 432-2133。我們的網站地址為 www.cloverhealth.com。網站上或可存取的資訊並非本 Form 10-K 年度報告的一部分，亦未被納入本 Form 10-K 年度報告的參考。

我們相信我們有機會透過科技驅動的提供者，為全國的醫療照護提供便捷的接觸方式，從而根本改變醫療照護。透過我們的 Clover Assistant 平台，我們相信我們可以提升每位提供者的照護水準，並以傳統的管理式照護計畫及風險承擔的提供者羣體所無法實現的方式進行擴張。我們主要透過部署醫師支援軟體來擴展我們的照護模式。我們主要透過與提供者簽訂契約，讓他們同意在他們的門診就診中使用 Clover Assistant，以換取固定費用。我們的平台，能夠提供差異化的患者照護，支持我們擴展至幾乎任何市場，包括傳統上被忽略的市場，這些市場通常因缺乏願意或能夠承擔患者照護成本的提供者而對其他人來說並不具可行性。
對於一個患者，我們的目標是為使用 Clover Assistant 的醫師提供合成的、整理過且可操作的資料集，以識別、管理並隨後治療疾病負擔。這些特徵的組合使醫師能夠為我們的受益者提供更好的患者體驗，因為醫師能夠更有效地利用數據驅動的、個性化的見解來識別臨牀機會以治療患者。

Clover Assistant 是一個專門設計的科技平台，使提供者能夠提供直覺的數據驅動、個性化的照護，以幫助醫師早期偵測、識別和管理疾病。這個醫師支援平台設計用以合成全面的、長期的資料集，以產生以提供者為中心的機器學習、人工智慧及基於規則的見解，並透過呈現與每位患者相關的最相關、個性化的資訊，來推動行動。透過這種資料存取的民主化，我們希望減少臨牀決策的變異性，推動對證據基準協議的更高順從度，並協助提供者提供更好的照護。我們的專有科技平台是本公司以科技為先的策略推動更好照護管理的核心。下圖顯示 Clover Assistant 系統介面的範例：

paragraphs: 以下討論與分析提供資訊，管理階層認為此資訊與評估及瞭解我們合併後之營運成果與財務狀況有關。討論應與本年度結算財務報表及其附註一併閱讀，財務報表為截至2025年12月31日止之年度財務資料，包含於本年度10-K表報（"10-K表"）。以下討論與分析未包含與截至2024年12月31日止年度相關之某些項目，包括2024年12月31日止年度與2023年12月31日止年度之年度比較。有關這些項目與我們2024年12月31日及2023年12月31日財務年度營運成果之比較，請參閱我們2024年12月31日年度10-K表之"管理階層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析"項目，該項目於2025年3月3日提交至證券交易委員會（SEC）。本討論包含前瞻性陳述，涉及多項風險與不確定性，包括但不限於本10-K表"風險因素"部分所描述之風險。實際結果可能與任何前瞻性陳述所載內容有重大差異。有關前瞻性陳述之警示資訊，請參閱"前瞻性陳述警示說明"。除非上下文另有明確要求，否則本"管理階層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析"中提及"我們"、"我們"、"我們"、"Clover"、"Clover Health"及"本公司"，均指Clover Health Investments, Corp.及其合併子公司之業務與營運。

在Clover Health，我們的願景是賦能每位醫師，使其能透過技術更早識別、管理與治療慢性疾病。我們的策略是改善有Medicare資格者之照護，建立廣泛的醫師網路，並提供技術協助賦能醫師。我們的專有軟體平台Clover Assistant（外部授權為Counterpart Assistant），協助我們執行此策略，使醫師能比平常更早偵測、識別與管理慢性疾病。此技術為雲端軟體平台，提供醫師針對其治療病患之資料驅動且個性化洞察。

我們經營Preferred Provider Organization（"PPO"）與Health Maintenance Organization（"HMO"）之Medicare Advantage（"MA"）計畫，供Medicare資格者使用。我們致力於為所有Medicare受益者提供高品質、可負擔之醫療照護。在具有相似主要特徵之計畫中，我們在MA計畫（"會員"）中提供最優惠的平均自付費用，為其市場之主要照護提供者與專科醫師共付費用。我們強烈相信提供會員選擇醫療提供者，我們認為PPO計畫為我們的旗艦保險產品。我們MA產品的重要特徵為廣泛的網路存取。我們相信透過Clover Assistant及相關資料洞察，可透過高度可擴展平台改善臨牀決策。截至2025年12月31日，我們在五州與200個縣市運作MA計畫，會員數為113,803人。
2026年1月14日，本公司宣佈其MA會員數較去年同期成長53%。本公司於2026年開年時擁有超過153,000名會員，其中超過97%為本公司旗艦PPO計畫之會員。
自2026年起，我們的MA計畫將於總計203個縣市與五州提供。
2025年10月9日，本公司宣佈CMS已將本公司PPO Medicare Advantage計畫之Star評分降低至2026年Star評分年份之3.5顆星，此評分將影響2027年支付年份。此外，CMS已將Clover HMO MA計畫評分提高至4.0顆星。目前，我們超過97%之保險會員為本公司PPO Medicare Advantage計畫之會員。
我們根據一個應報告分部：保險，來管理營運。透過我們的保險分部，我們為多個州之Medicare Advantage會員提供PPO與HMO計畫。所有其他臨牀服務與所有公司總部開支，未包含於應報告分部者，均歸入公司/其他。
分部分組與我們首席執行長（被識別為我們之首席營運決策者（"CODM"））用以評估績效與分配本公司資源之資訊一致。
我們審視數個關鍵績效指標，如後述所說明，以評估我們的業務與成果、衡量績效、識別趨勢、擬定計畫，並做出戰略決策。我們認為，呈現這些指標有助於管理階層與對應方，以建模評估如 Clover 這樣的醫療保健公司之表現。
透過我們的保險業務部門，我們在多個州為會員提供 PPO 與 HMO 計畫。我們透過軟體平台 Clover Assistant，以直覺化的數據驅動、個性化洞察，賦能提供者，以支持會員的治療，進而改善照護並降低成本。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關的風險
我們過去曾產生淨虧損，且我們可能無法在未來實現或維持盈利。
我們的長期成功取決於維持並持續改善CA，以及將CA擴展至外部夥伴，因此，我們的過去績效可能無法反映未來表現。
若Clover Assistant的採用與使用程度低於我們預期，我們的成長可能減緩或停止。我們可能經歷 Clover 管理下生命週期的下降，且我們的營運結果可能受到不利影響。
CMS 的風險調整付款制度使我們的收入與盈利難以預測，並可能導致我們營運結果的重大追溯調整。
我們可能需要額外資金來支持業務成長，而此資金可能無法在可接受的條件下取得，甚至無法取得。
若我們無法成功維持或擴大我們MA計畫下的成員數量，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果造成損害。
我們的成員仍集中於某些地理區域及人口羣，這使我們面臨當地福利成本、報銷率、競爭及經濟條件不利變動的風險。
本公司營運成果可能因無法擴展提供者網路或以具競爭力的條件與提供者、醫療機構及其他機構簽訂協議而受到不利影響。
本公司可能無法有效管理成長，這可能會對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生重大不利影響。
本公司所處產業為競爭性產業，若本公司無法有效競爭，將會對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成損害。
本公司與較大型公司競爭，這些公司可能擁有較強的品牌，而競爭對手之間的併購將增加競爭。
本公司若無法準確預估已發生但尚未報告的聲請，將會影響本公司營運成果。
若本公司無法擴展銷售與行銷基礎設施，或無法克服與本公司業務行銷相關的挑戰，則可能無法招收足夠會員以達成預測。
若本公司未能發展廣泛的品牌認知度，或無法維持或提升本公司聲譽，將會對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成損害。
若本公司無法持續創新並提供對會員及提供者有用的服務，則可能無法保持競爭力，而本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果可能會受損。
若本公司未能提供高品質的客戶支援，將可能影響本公司業務、營運成果及聲譽。
若 Clover Assistant 存在實質或被認為存在錯誤、故障、漏洞或蟲蟲，將可能損害本公司業務、營運成果及財務狀況。
若本公司未能有效管理技術營運基礎設施，或遭遇平台服務中斷、延誤或部署延宕，將可能影響營運成果。
paragraphs: 在進行業務運作的過程中，我們面臨多種風險，任何一種風險都可能影響或嚴重影響我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果。若其中一個或數個風險與不確定性發生，我們的普通股市場價格可能下降，甚至大幅且永久性下跌。本報告或我們其他 SEC 檔案中所描述的任何因素，本身或與其他因素共同作用，都可能對我們的財務狀況及營運結果造成不利影響。

我們在 2025 年 12 月 31 日結止年度、2024 年 12 月 31 日結止年度及 2023 年 12 月 31 日結止年度分別產生淨虧損 85.5 百萬美元、46.3 百萬美元及 210.1 百萬美元，且截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們的累積虧損約為 2.3 十億美元。我們可能在近期內繼續產生虧損，因為我們持續投入大量資金以促進業務成長。特別是，我們預期會繼續投資於改善 Clover Assistant 及我們的科技基礎設施、發展我們的臨牀照護方案、提高 Clover Assistant 平台的採用率，包括透過 Counterpart Health、擴大我們的行銷與拓展努力、擴大我們的地理運作範圍，以及發展未來的產品以改善照護並補充我們的收入來源。這些努力可能比我們目前預期的更昂貴，我們可能無法成功提高收入以彌補這些開支。即使我們成功提高來自保險 premiums 的總收入，我們也可能無法成功預測、定價並管理醫療費用。

此外，我們可能無法在後續期間維持獲利。我們的營運現金流在 2025 年 12 月 31 日結止年度及 2023 年 12 月 31 日結止年度為負，而在 2024 年 12 月 31 日結止年度為正，我們可能在任何特定期間無法產生正的營運現金流。若我們無法維持獲利或實現正的營運現金流，我們將需要額外的資金，而這些資金可能無法以有利的條件取得，甚至無法取得，這可能會稀釋我們股東的權益。請參閱風險因素「我們可能需要額外資金以支應業務成長，而此資金可能無法以可接受的條件取得，甚至無法取得。」若我們無法成功解決這些風險與挑戰，我們的業務可能受到損害，這可能會對我們普通股的價值產生負面影響。

自 2018 年推出 Clover Assistant 以來，我們持續發展其功能與能力，調整我們的市場策略，並調整其與我們的 MA 計畫及第三方系統的整合。因此，我們可能無法完全瞭解 Clover Assistant 對我們未來業務與長期前景的影響。我們長期的成功取決於維持並持續改善 Clover Assistant，以及我們在現有市場或潛在未來市場中從其運作中產生的毛利率。無法保證這些效果會持續改善或在現有市場中持續存在，也無法保證我們能在擴展至新市場時重複這些成果，若未能做到，可能會對我們的業務與營運結果產生負面影響。請參閱風險因素「我們推出 Counterpart Assistant 作為一個 Software-as-a-Service（"SaaS"）產品，供外部支付者及服務 Medicare 合格人口的提供者使用，可能不會成功，因此我們的業務可能受到不利影響。」
我們推出 Counterpart Assistant 作為一個 Software-as-a-Service（"SaaS"）產品，供外部支付者及服務 Medicare 合格人口的提供者使用，可能不會成功，因此我們的業務可能受到不利影響。

在 2024 年第二季，我們推出了 Counterpart Health, Inc.（"Counterpart Health"），為本公司之子公司，提供一個 SaaS 與科技驅動的服務方案，將 Clover Assistant 技術的優勢帶給服務 Medicare 合格人口的外部支付者及提供者，品牌為 "Counterpart Assistant"，目標是將數據驅動的已驗證科技與個性化照護的效益擴展至更廣大的羣眾，提升患者的照護結果並降低全國的醫療成本。Counterpart Assistant 與 Clover Assistant 互為補充，除非文意另有明確說明，否則本報告中提及 Clover Assistant 的風險也同時適用於 Counterpart Assistant，如適用。
